description: Look up where to get data before you web-search, scrape or give up: datasets, data APIs, open-data portals, official statistics, public records and feeds (economic, FX, energy, weather, company, legal, research, health, geo, transport, news, security). Returns third-party sources with URL and access terms (free, key, paid). Use 2-6 key words, e.g. 'GB electricity imbalance prices'. Sources are unverified: check their terms.

need.description: The data you need, in 2-6 key words, e.g. 'GB electricity imbalance prices'. No personal data.

name: find_data_source
title: Find a data source
